_comment: Local knowledge base for Siviez — collected from Pepijn (resident) + official sources. Used to build the Discover / Eat & drink / Practical pages. All facts verified where possible.

eat_and_drink.name: Chez Caroline
eat_and_drink.location: Rosablanche building (same block as apartment C34)
eat_and_drink.highlight: In the very building of Rosablanche C34 — coffee, meals and fresh bread a lift ride from the apartment.
eat_and_drink.summer: Sunny terrace at the foot of the slopes, relaxed lunches to the sound of cowbells.
eat_and_drink.winter: Terrace at the foot of the ski slopes, plus the Yeti Bar.
eat_and_drink.menu: Seasonal — burgers, salads, soups, grilled meats, breakfast, sandwiches to go.
eat_and_drink.bakery: Bread and croissants to order (order the day before, pick up next morning).

eat_and_drink.name: Restaurant Les Bergers
eat_and_drink.highlight: Alpine-atmosphere restaurant with traditional Valais dishes and open-hearth grills.
eat_and_drink.menu: Open-hearth grills, cheese dishes, local Valais specialities.

eat_and_drink.name: Restaurant de Combatseline
eat_and_drink.highlight: Panoramic terrace at 2238m — reachable by chairlift or on foot, on the Bisse de Chervé hike.
eat_and_drink.menu: Traditional local dishes; kids' Cheesy menu; house liqueur 'le penché'.

stay_other.name: Auberge de Siviez
stay_other.highlight: 100-bed mountain lodge for groups — youth & sports camps, seminars, family celebrations, weddings.

ski_school.name: École Suisse de Ski Nendaz (ESS Nendaz)
ski_school.location: Sales office / bureau in the Rosablanche building (same block as apartment C34)
ski_school.highlight: The official Swiss Ski School — its Siviez desk is in the Rosablanche building, so lessons are booked a floor away from the apartment.

lifts_from_siviez._note: Three lifts leave from the Siviez station (Les 4 Vallées), right by Rosablanche C34 — ski-in/ski-out in three directions.

lifts.name: Combatseline
lifts.opens_up: Veysonnaz / Thyon; in summer the Bisse de Chervé & Mont-Rouge hikes; mountain restaurant on top.

lifts.name: Tortin
lifts.opens_up: Col des Gentianes → Mont-Fort (3330m) and Verbier.

lifts.name: Siviez–Plan du Fou
lifts.opens_up: Nendaz / Tracouet / Prarion — shares cabins with Prarion–Plan du Fou, so no change needed towards Nendaz.

landmarks.name: Lac de Cleuson
landmarks.facts: Turquoise reservoir at ~2179m behind the Cleuson dam. Holds the water of the Printse river.
landmarks.dam: Cleuson dam built 1947–1950, 87m high, 420m long, holds 20 million m³. Part of the Grande Dixence hydroelectric scheme.
landmarks.access: About 1h15 walk up from Siviez along the Printse; guided tours inside the dam wall in season.

landmarks.name: Chapelle Saint-Barthélémy
landmarks.facts: The oldest chapel in Nendaz — a 1447 document already mentions it, so it predates that. Originally stood in the Cleuson valley; the current stone chapel was built in 1951 by the dam workers after the dam was built. It sits just behind the Cleuson dam.
landmarks.tradition: Cheeses from the mountain pastures are blessed here every year on 24 August.

landmarks.name: La Printse
landmarks.facts: The river that runs down the Nendaz valley (Vallée de la Printze). Feeds Lac de Cleuson. A barefoot path (2.4 km, ~45 min) and a family picnic area with BBQ follow it near Siviez.

landmarks.name: Refuge de Saint-Laurent
landmarks.facts: Refuge at 2522m by Lac de Cleuson, on the Combatseline → Bisse de Chervé → Cleuson loop.
landmarks.hike: Combatseline chairlift → along the old Bisse de Chervé → Refuge de Saint-Laurent → Lac de Cleuson → down the east bank via the dam back to Siviez (~16.6 km loop).

landmarks.name: Lac du Grand Désert
landmarks.facts: High-alpine lake reached from the Printse valley above Siviez; visible on the H5 view.

parking.apartment: Rosablanche C34 has a guaranteed reserved space on a barrier-controlled car park (parking card provided).
